sentences.text: The night was quiet, but several areas stayed below 18.0 °C, which is noted in the bathroom, living room, parents' room, and office.
The bathroom was the coldest at 17.0 °C at 03:50, and the parents' room was also cold at 17.5 °C at 00:00.
Since all rooms stayed below 18.0 °C, please consider checking the heating system to keep things cozy.
